propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) under the tracked .rebar/ directory so trends accumulate across CI runs.
The write_snapshot(dict) function appends timestamped records to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson and read_snapshots(since,until) retrieves records within a date range.
The snapshot file path must be explicitly un-ignored in .gitignore via !.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson because a blanket .rebar/* rule otherwise silences the file and prevents persistence.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines must be skipped without raising exceptions, allowing the reader to return only valid records from the store.
Unit tests must verify round-trip write/read, range filtering, corruption resilience, and that the snapshot store is not matched by the repo's .gitignore rules.
